recurring_rules_note_valid.name: recurring_rules_note_valid
recurring_rules_note_valid.value: "recurring_rules"."note" is null or length(trim("recurring_rules"."note")) between 1 and 500

recurring_rules_pause_reason_valid.name: recurring_rules_pause_reason_valid
recurring_rules_pause_reason_valid.value:
("recurring_rules"."status" = 'paused' and "recurring_rules"."pause_reason" is not null)
        or ("recurring_rules"."status" <> 'paused' and "recurring_rules"."pause_reason" is null)

recurring_rules_end_not_before_start.name: recurring_rules_end_not_before_start
recurring_rules_end_not_before_start.value:
"recurring_rules"."end_date" is null or "recurring_rules"."end_date" >=
        ("recurring_rules"."start_at" at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta')::date
